: Provenance: HAND-AUTHORED under SMA-316 (PR #30), not captured from the
: wire. SMA-522 (PR #197) changed it. The `content_filter` finish value has
: no capture. The SMA-522 design says that no mock can provoke it.
:
: What follows the capture, and what does not. The chunk sequence (content
: delta, finish chunk, a separate trailing usage chunk, `[DONE]`) follows the
: LiteLLM capture in chat_text_usage_trailing.txt. The envelope does not
: follow it. Here the usage chunk has the keys `id`, `object`, `created`,
: `model`; the capture has `id`, `created`, `model`, `object`. This file has
: no `completion_tokens_details`. The values `id` "x", `created` 1700000000
: and model "gpt-4o" are not from a capture. The usage chunk keeps the proxy
: form `"choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{}}]`, not `"choices":[]`.
:
: History. SMA-316 (PR #30) wrote this file with `usage` on the finish
: chunk. SMA-522 (PR #197) moved `usage` to its own trailing chunk.
